column1: Preheat the oven to 400°F (204°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment or silicone mats.
Toss the chicken pieces with the flour until coated.
Mix the corn flakes, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika in a large bowl. Whisk the eggs and milk in a separate bowl.
Dip each piece in the egg mixture, let the excess drip off, then roll in the corn flake mixture and place on the sheets.
Bake about 18 minutes, flipping halfway, then let cool 5 minutes.
Meanwhile simmer the BBQ sauce, honey, and ketchup in a small saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes, whisking now and then.
Put the chicken in a large bowl, pour the warm sauce over, and stir gently to coat. Serve warm.
